content.short: Stablecoin card and white-label payments platform.
content.description: Gnosis Pay is a self-custodial payments platform that connects on-chain stablecoins to the traditional card network, letting users spend directly from their own smart-contract wallet with a Visa debit card. Purchases settle by pulling stablecoins such as EURe and USDC from the user's account at the point of sale, so funds stay non-custodial until spent. Built on Gnosis Chain and expanding to the Celo ecosystem, Gnosis Pay also offers a white-label program that lets fintechs and DeFi projects launch their own branded stablecoin cards on top of its rails. Serving consumers and businesses across Europe and globally, it aims to make self-custodied stablecoins usable for everyday purchases anywhere cards are accepted.
